COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_lock_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_locked } COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_ready = yes }
		if = { limit = { SWE = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_SWE }
		if = { limit = { NRY = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_NRY }
		if = { limit = { DEN = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_DEN }
		if = { limit = { FIN = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_FIN }
		if = { limit = { ICE = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_candidate = yes } } set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_seat_ICE }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_labour_locked
	}
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_pay_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_can_pay = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_quote = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.005 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_contribution = COLDWAR_NORDIC_quote }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = COLDWAR_NORDIC_quote multiply = -1 } }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_bank_paid
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_route_1
	}
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_mark_investment_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.PREV.id } } NOT = { has_war_with = PREV.PREV } } AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_named_project_earned } PREV.PREV = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_named_project_earned } } OR = { check_variable = { PREV.PREV.project_type = 1 } check_variable = { PREV.PREV.project_type = 4 } check_variable = { PREV.PREV.project_type = 5 } } COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_ready = yes }
		set_variable = { PREV.PREV.COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_kind^PREV.PREV.project = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.PREV.id } } NOT = { has_war_with = PREV.PREV } } AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_environmental_fund_earned } PREV.PREV = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_environmental_fund_earned } } OR = { check_variable = { PREV.PREV.project_type = 11 } check_variable = { PREV.PREV.project_type = 14 } } COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_ready = yes }
		set_variable = { PREV.PREV.COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_kind^PREV.PREV.project = 2 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_NORDIC_register_investment_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.PREV.id } } NOT = { has_war_with = PREV.PREV } } AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_ready = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_named_project_earned } PREV.PREV = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_ready = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_named_project_earned } } check_variable = { PREV.PREV.COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_kind^PREV.PREV.project = 1 } check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.PREV.project_target_country^PREV.PREV.project } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_project_delivered
		PREV.PREV = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_project_delivered }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_finance_project_delivered
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.PREV.id } } NOT = { has_war_with = PREV.PREV } } AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_ready = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_environmental_fund_earned } PREV.PREV = { AND = { COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_frozen = yes COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_ready = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_environmental_fund_earned } } check_variable = { PREV.PREV.COLDWAR_NORDIC_investment_kind^PREV.PREV.project = 2 } check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.PREV.project_target_country^PREV.PREV.project } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_project_delivered
		PREV.PREV = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_NORDIC_services_project_delivered }
	}
}
